auth.ai.title: 🤖 AI usage guide for this token
auth.ai.desc: Paste this into your agent's system prompt (or chat) so the AI knows what it may do with this account.
auth.ai.intro: You (the AI agent) may use this pre-authorized token via the Auth Manager extension to:
auth.ai.outro: When the user requests these tasks, use the matching skill/API with this credential — do not ask them to log in again, and do not exceed the scopes listed above.
auth.ai.cap_youtube: Manage the YouTube channel: videos, playlists, metadata, comments
auth.ai.cap_drive: Manage & upload files on Google Drive
auth.ai.how_token: How to get the access token (auto-refresh):
auth.ai.note_bearer: Every Google API call must send header: Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
auth.ai.optA_desc: Contains NO secrets. The AI gets capabilities + API recipes; when a token is needed you run a one-line command in the server Terminal and paste the printed token to the AI (expires ~1h, just re-run).
auth.ai.optB_pros: ✅ Pros: works immediately from any machine or cloud AI (ChatGPT, Claude…) — no server access needed; includes a remote token-refresh recipe.
auth.ai.optB_risks: ⚠ Risks: the guide contains a LIVE Google access token — anyone who sees it can use these permissions until you Revoke; it will be stored in the third-party AI chat history. The refresh recipe has a <TUBECLI_PASSWORD> placeholder — filling it in exposes full control of this server. You accept these risks yourself.
auth.ai.optB_confirm: I understand the risks — create full guide
auth.ai.safe_remote_title: Use from another machine / cloud AI:
auth.ai.safe_remote_body: Run this in the server Terminal (open it via cloud from any machine), then paste the printed ACCESS_TOKEN to your AI. Re-run when it expires (~1h):
auth.ai.full_warn: ⚠ SECRET — this guide contains a LIVE access token. Share only with AI/services you trust. Revoke the token in Auth Manager if it leaks.
auth.ai.full_refresh: Get a fresh token from anywhere when expired (replace <TUBECLI_PASSWORD> with the TubeCLI password):
auth.ai.endpoint_missing: (!) This server does not have the access-token endpoint yet — run the server update command, restart TubeCLI, then generate this guide again.
auth.badge.auto_refresh_tip: Google access tokens only live ~1 hour by design. This token has a refresh token, so the system silently gets a fresh one every time it is used — no action needed. If refreshing starts failing after ~7 days: your OAuth consent screen is in "Testing" mode (Google revokes refresh tokens after 7 days there). Fix once: Google Cloud Console -> OAuth consent screen -> Publish app, then Authorize again.
